text:
nicole: Quick postmortem follow-up from the 02:40 UTC incident — repeated low-priority pages during nightly maintenance window. Putting owners and short actions here.

nicole: Problem summary: scheduled batch jobs retried aggressively after transient DB timeouts, generating hundreds of P4 alerts that bypassed dedupe. Paging routed to SRE rota instead of infra owners due to legacy rule.

nicole: High level remediation plan (owners + targets):
- tim -> threshold + alert rule updates for batch job family (target: Thu 18:00 UTC)
- jess -> dedupe fingerprinting + increase coat window, PR to observability repo (target: Mon)
- raj -> paging routing change; ensure infra-owner primary, platform-sre fallback after 45m (target: Fri)
- marcus -> nightly suppression runbook + feature-flag rollout (target: Fri)

tim: I'll take thresholds. first pass: raise timeout alert from 20s -> 120s for backfill jobs and add a slope check to catch sustained growth.

jess: plan: dedupe by (cluster, job_group, error_class) and add a rolling window of 15m. will stage in staging and watch noise delta.

raj: routing note: need to update the channel mapping in routing-config and create a canary route for one infra team first. propose fallback to platform-sre after 45m with a soft page (no phone) at 30m.

marcus: runbook will include automated suppression when job_label=="maintenance" or tag=="nightly_backfill". I'll attach FF for safety. sample suppression rule below for review:

```json
{"id":"ff-nightly-suppress","match":"job_label==\"nightly_backfill\" && severity==\"P4\"","suppress_minutes":360,"notify":"#observability-ops"}
```

oncall-bot: ticket created: PM-8391 "Reduce nightly backfill alert noise" assigned to @tim @jess @raj @marcus  https://issues.redwood.example/PM-8391

nicole: Please reply once you have a 1-line update. I want to roll these into the remediation tracker before next week's ops sync. Also adding a small eval to Redwood Optimize to check for false negatives after threshold increases.

tim: status: collected 3d of metrics, 95pct for backfill = 89s, proposing alert at 150s and a derivative rule to detect ramps. will open PR by tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

jess: status: dedupe PR opened (#429). testing in staging, saw 72% reduction in duplicate alerts during synthetic replay. :construction:

raj: status: routing change drafted and reviewed with infra lead. canary scheduled Fri 02:00 UTC for infra-east. fallback behavior included.

marcus: status: runbook draft posted, FF created in flags service, security review requested. link: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/nightly-backfill

nicole: timeline: if staging metrics look good, plan prod flip Mon 03:00 UTC, runbook applies immediately after flip. I'll monitor the ticket and tag for closure when all owners confirm prod success.

jess: noted. if noise <85% after prod flip, we can consider loosening grouping keys after 2w.

tim: will add eval traces to the Optimize set and run a quick post-change quality check.

marcus: once security gives thumbs up, I'll enable FF in canary environment.

nicole: final: adding incident signature (owner: nicole) to recurring-incidents doc so automated detectors can match this pattern going forward. thanks team! :thumbsup:
